Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. The activation conditions include paying 2 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 5 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, therefore the effect can't be activated just by paying 2 cost.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to pay 2 cost even when I don't have any [Legend-Arms] trait or level 5 Digimon?

Effect: {Hand} [Main] By paying 2 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 5 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, that Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect adds to this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ and ＜Piercing＞ for the turn.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon's attack target is switched, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
